prompt: Complete a consented social-platform action specified by the requester and submit only the minimum evidence required by the compiled policy.
Complete a second consented social action on a different target and provide task-bound evidence.
Complete a social interaction with a time requirement and submit evidence showing both target and completion state.
Complete a social action requiring two policy checks and provide minimally sufficient evidence.
Change a harmless account preference in a research or participant-owned account and submit privacy-scoped evidence.
Enable or disable a non-sensitive account setting and show the resulting state without exposing unrelated account data.
Complete a reversible profile configuration and submit only policy-relevant evidence.
Publish a consented test post containing required non-sensitive content and submit evidence of publication.
Publish a second test item with a required phrase or tag and provide task-bound evidence.
Publish content with a time-window requirement and provide evidence sufficient to check freshness.
Publish a multi-field test item and submit evidence supporting every required field.
Submit a harmless research form and provide evidence that confirms submission without revealing form answers.
Upload a non-sensitive test document to a participant-controlled destination and provide minimal completion evidence.
Complete a test submission with two required fields and provide evidence scoped to completion status.
Capture a current, non-sensitive digital state whose validity depends on a defined time window.
Confirm a temporary status in a participant-owned service and provide freshness-relevant evidence.
Complete a reversible action before a stated deadline and provide time-bound evidence.
Complete a digital action requiring two evidence items that must refer to the same target and outcome.
Provide a link and an image for one completed digital outcome so their task binding can be compared.
Complete a multi-step digital task and provide evidence whose sequence and final state are mutually consistent.
